name: Väljasõidukohustuse ja sissesõidukeelu seadus
name_en: Obligation to Leave and Prohibition on Entry Act

sections.title: Lahkumisettekirjutus
sections.body: Written precept to leave issued to persons residing unlawfully in Estonia. Must specify departure deadline (7-30 days), receiving country, applicable entry ban, and enforcement warnings.

sections.title: Väljasaatmise alused
sections.body: Grounds for forced removal – applies when voluntary departure deadline expires; removal may proceed without prior order in specific urgent cases.

sections.title: Vastuvõttev riik
sections.body: Receiving country: (1) country of citizenship, (2) transit country per EU/bilateral agreements, (3) third country with consent. Persons with Schengen residence rights return to that Schengen state.

sections.title: Kinnipidamiskeskusse paigutamine
sections.body: Placement in detention centre – authorised up to 2 months when supervision measures prove ineffective (flight risk, non-cooperation, missing return documents). Extensions possible by court up to 18 months total.

sections.title: Sissesõidukeelu õiguslikud tagajärjed
sections.body: Legal consequences of entry ban: prohibition on entering Estonia and Schengen area, prohibition on residence.

sections.title: Sissesõidukeelu kohaldamise alused
sections.body: Grounds for imposing entry ban on third-country nationals: unlawful residence, serious crime, threat to public order/security.

sections.title: Lahkumiskohustuse täitmise tähtaja määramine
sections.body: Voluntary departure deadline 7-30 days; extendable up to 30 additional days in hardship cases; immediate enforcement permitted if flight risk or security threat.
